status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Acceptance criteria are implemented, checks passed, and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Google sign-in and revocable sessions
features.behavior: Create or find one active application account by Google subject, issue an application session, and revoke sessions on logout or account deletion.
features.verification: After backend setup, verify first and repeat Google sign-in, protected routes, invalid or expired sessions, logout, and account deletion using backend tests.

features.title: Owner-only link management
features.behavior: Authenticated active users can create, list, inspect, edit, deactivate, reactivate, and delete only their own links.
features.verification: After backend setup, verify CRUD, active-account authorization, and cross-owner isolation with API integration tests.

features.title: Unique codes and permanent reservation
features.behavior: Normalize friendly codes, generate unique codes, and permanently reserve codes released by code changes or deletion.
features.verification: After backend setup, verify normalization, collisions including concurrent claims, and non-reuse after link or account deletion.

features.title: Public redirects reflect current link state
features.behavior: Active current codes return a non-cached temporary redirect to the complete validated destination; unavailable codes reveal no owner data.
features.verification: After backend setup, verify active, changed, disabled, deleted, prior, and unknown codes plus destination path, query, fragment, and ignored incoming parameters.

features.title: Transactional account deletion
features.behavior: Delete the authenticated user's account, links, and sessions atomically while retaining unlinked reserved codes; a failure must not be reported as success.
features.verification: After backend setup, verify successful deletion, session invalidation, retained unlinked codes, and rollback behavior on failure.

features.description: A visitor can sign in with Google and see their authenticated link-management area.
steps: Open the application while signed out.
Start Google sign-in and complete the provider flow.
Verify the authenticated interface appears and a repeat sign-in uses the same account.

features.description: An authenticated owner can create and manage links in the dashboard.
steps: Create a link with a valid destination and friendly or generated code.
Verify its short URL, destination, state, and dates appear in the dashboard.
Edit its destination, deactivate and reactivate it, and verify each state in the interface.

features.description: Code changes and destructive actions clearly warn the user and require explicit confirmation.
steps: Start a code change and verify the old address warning appears before confirmation.
Start link deletion and account deletion, then cancel each and verify data remains unchanged.
Confirm each action and verify the resulting link or account is unavailable.
